data.name: AnimalSchool
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to [AnimalSchool], a vibrant and challenging animal school simulation tycoon game! You will play as an ambitious headmaster, starting from a rundown rural animal school with just a few classrooms. Through your wisdom and management, you will ultimately build it into a world-renowned top-tier aristocratic academy.

🎓 In-Depth Simulation, Care for Every Student
Your students—a bunch of adorable yet mischievous little animals—have independent stats for Hunger, Mood, Knowledge, Health, and Comfort. You must carefully plan their daily schedule: find the perfect balance between teaching and playtime to ensure they are well-fed, happy, and healthy. Remember, a sick or unhappy student can't learn effectively!

🏗️ Build Freely, Plan Your Dream Campus
From essential buildings like Classrooms, Offices, and Cafeterias to luxurious facilities like Swimming Pools, Gardens, and Playgrounds, unlock and upgrade over 14 different types of buildings. Strategically plan your campus layout, construct infrastructure like Power Plants and Water Facilities, and lay a solid foundation for expansion. Use beautiful decorations to create a unique campus landscape.

👨‍🏫 Recruit a Team, Handle Unexpected Challenges
You can't do it alone! Hire and upgrade your staff: diligent Teachers for lessons, efficient Janitors for cleanliness, professional Chefs for delicious meals, and reliable Repairmen on standby to fix broken facilities. Emergencies happen, and a strong team is key to your success.

💰 Operate Smartly, Become an Academy Tycoon
Your core goal is profit maximization. Earn substantial tuition fees by improving teaching efficiency, keeping student morale high, and minimizing the impact of incidents. Reinvest your profits to unlock new areas, upgrade equipment, and hire more staff, creating a powerful growth cycle. Can you build an efficient, prosperous, and joyful educational empire?

✨ Game Features

  • A Lively Animal School World: Manage a group of animal students each with their own personalities and needs.

  • Multi-Dimensional Simulation Management: Dive deep into teaching, logistics, facility maintenance, and financial operations.

  • Rich Construction & Upgrade System: Start from scratch, freely plan and expand your unique campus.

  • Strategic Daily Planning: Balance student stats, handle random events, and make critical decisions.

  • A Sense of Progressive Achievement: Experience the complete epic journey from a shabby elementary school to a luxurious aristocratic academy.

Are you ready for the challenge? Enroll your first students now and begin writing your own educational legend!
